name: @xpert-ai/plugin-story-studio
description: Agentic story adaptation studio for reviewable planning and production workflows.
author: XpertAI

interface.shortDescription: Agentic story adaptation and production planning
interface.longDescription: Create scoped story projects through eight reviewable stages, generate and select shot videos through Seedance, optionally render an animatic, then freeze a versioned StoryCutHandoff for professional editing in Cut.
defaultPrompt: Create a vertical short-drama project from my premise.
Review the current story project and recommend the next production stage.
Move the selected project into planning after I approve the brief.
Build a three-shot production plan and render a storyboard MP4.

description.en_US: Plan and review story adaptation and media-production stages.
description.zh_Hans: 规划和审核故事改编与媒体制作阶段。

description.en_US: Create scoped, revision-safe story-production projects.
description.zh_Hans: 创建带作用域和版本保护的故事制作项目。

description.en_US: Inspect project status, format, revision, and next production stage.
description.zh_Hans: 检查项目状态、格式、版本和下一制作阶段。

description.en_US: Apply explicit, reviewable project metadata and status changes.
description.zh_Hans: 应用明确、可审核的项目元数据和状态变更。

description.en_US: Queue a durable storyboard MP4 from the reviewed scene and shot plan.
description.zh_Hans: 根据已审核的场景与镜头计划异步渲染分镜 MP4。

description.en_US: Attach one completed, scoped Seedance Workspace MP4 to an exact production shot.
description.zh_Hans: 将已完成且作用域匹配的 Seedance Workspace MP4 绑定到指定制作镜头。

description.en_US: Freeze selected Workspace MP4s into StoryCutHandoff v1 and deliver a Cut project or review proposal.
description.zh_Hans: 将已选 Workspace MP4 冻结为 StoryCutHandoff v1，并交付 Cut 项目或审核提案。

description.en_US: Project and production-stage review Workbench.
description.zh_Hans: 项目与制作阶段审核工作台。

description.en_US: Strict project lifecycle tools with scope, pagination, revision checks, and failure reporting.
description.zh_Hans: 提供作用域、分页、版本检查和失败上报的严格项目生命周期工具。

description.zh_Hans: 使用支持版本保护的 Story Studio 工具管理有作用域的故事制作项目。
